names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Вонифатий (Виноградский) Феофановский, Киевский, игумен, прп.»: «игумен» and «прп.» are rank words and are stripped, the surname and both epithets kept. The day line itself declines to «Вонифатия Феофановского, Киевского» and gives no surname at all. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1871)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 27 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Вонифатия Феофановского, Киевского (1871).»

attestations.note: The day’s fifth entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. «Прп.» is the `venerable` and «игумен» the `abbot` and the office `Abbot`; «Феофановского» is the Theophania hermitage at Kyiv and «Киевского» the city, and both are kept inside the stored name form rather than turned into an `office` the locale packs do not carry. A Cyrillic grep for «Виноградский» over every `saint.json` returns `nicholas-vinogradsky` alone — another forename and another day — and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page carries four hymns — three for the protomartyr Stephen and one for the venerable Theodore — and none under this name.
